Restores each IG's AST from its cache branch and writes fhir-artifact-index/ (index.json, menu.json with the source.of/source.ref that Task_Stage clones from, releases.json, package.tgz). A missing input skips that instance, named. BPMN activities of fhir-harness · source fhir-harness/processes/tools/ig-docs-site-compose.bpmn#Task_Indexes . Build each slice into _site at deploy candidate, extracted gen-slice-sqlite.ts --out ./_site/assets/slices --payload-out ./_site/payload/sha256 --slice <name>, once per slice, from the tree being published: the file, its manifest, the slice index, and the deploy payloads beside the committed KG payloads. Never into the committed docs/payload/, whose orphan audit admits KG nodes only. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/slice-sqlite-publish.bpmn#A_Deploy . Build into its own chrome-less route candidate, extracted Tool web-app-build (web-apps:build, run with the other declared visualiser writers): each locale's strings are written to <i18n.out>/<locale>.json from the .po (building is the injection), the app installs from its lockfile and builds, and the build is copied to <locale>/<harness>/apps/<id>/ with every page marked folio-navbar: none and rendered-by: web-app-build; the apps/ index lists every app with its size. No other page embeds an app, so it loads only when a reader opens its route. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/web-app-publish.bpmn#A_Build . Build it locally and measure the file candidate, extracted Run bun run cat slice:sqlite -- --slice <name> --out <scratch> and read the manifest: bytes, the row counts, the payload count and bytes, overBudget, duplicateIds and findings. Record the measurement in the work context with its provenance (the command and the date), beside the size of the source it replaces. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/slice-sqlite-publish.bpmn#A_Measure . Build staging site candidate, extracted feature-staging.yml triggers: 1. Regenerate docs (schema, skills, content-backed pages) 2. Render BPMN diagrams 3. Stamp build with commit SHA + timestamp + branch 4. Build Jekyll site with branches/ baseurl 5. Inject yellow staging banner into every HTML page A draft pull request is staged too, from its first push. A build takes about 22 minutes, and GitHub Pages about 3 to 4 more. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/content-change-review-stage.bpmn#Task_BuildStaging . Build the docs site candidate, extracted Build the preview from the PR's head (or, on an off-critical-path verify_pr dispatch, rebuild refs/pull/<n>/merge in full to verify an agent-built preview) and write _build-record.json: regenerate the generated docs, trim what this preview does not need, render the BPMN diagrams, then Jekyll, TypeDoc and the knowledge-graph export, with the staging banner and SEO identity claims stripped. It is a PREVIEW build (CAT_BUILD_TYPE=preview, owner 2026-11-01): only what the change reaches, and every whole-corpus index (builtAtPublish entries marked index: true, and the search index) is main's copy, put back rather than rebuilt. A branch frozen for public comment is dispatched with build_type: full instead. Skill feature-staging, section Build types. A PREVIEW REBUILDS ONLY ITS DEPENDENCY CONE (owner cards Q-CONE-1 C and Q-CONE-2 B, 2026-11-01): main's writer records say what each derive:publish writer and each step of the QA working copy READ. A writer or QA step whose recorded reads all match is not run, and main's outputs for it are put back. Every other one runs. QA is not left out of a preview, only narrowed to what the change can reach. Inside a preview's QA build, skill:register also leaves to derive:publish the two pages that derive:publish builds anyway and that no later QA step reads (skills:docs and lsi:viz), so they are built once. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/feature-staging.bpmn#Task_Build . Build the draft publication candidate, extracted Render the corpus into the draft form of the folio: PDF, HTML site, or FHIR IG. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/draft-to-publication.bpmn#Task_BuildDraft . Build the entry candidate, extracted First the working copy is produced (qa:refresh, bean 3hk4): while the checkout still tracks test/results/, the commit's own copy is the record and nothing runs; once it does not, every declared QA writer runs into the empty tree, because the gates are in judge mode and wrote nothing a publish could carry. A refresh that leaves a writer failed, a family empty or a file unclaimed is INCOMPLETE: the job goes red and qa:publish --completeness refuses, so a partial tree is never stored as the commit's record — the "Not stored" outcome, reached before any push. Then it hashes the working copy of every declared qa directory (<instance>/test/results/**, byte-identical to the checkout's layout) into a tree through a private index, and writes manifest.json (qa-reports-manifest/v1): inputs, producers, verdict counts and the gates' result. Identical JSON is the same blob, so an unchanged family costs nothing to store again. Its git objects live in a private bare repository, never in the checkout's own store. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/qa-publish.bpmn#Task_BuildEntry . Build the IG with the AST exporter candidate, extracted The runner mounts the layers the IG repository's index.lock.json pins, then restores and judges the cache itself. When it is not valid (or force is set) it rebuilds with the Publisher fork (Tool ig-ast-export, litlfred/fhir-ig-publisher at the pinned claude/ast-export commit). A stale cache is first rebuilt incrementally (IncrementalBuildCli), falling back to a full AstExportCli build with -tx; a force run, a pre-export caller, or a missing or cannot-tell cache always builds in full, and a release needs a full build. The caller's optional pre-export overlay command runs before a full build; the inputs it changed are put back and the AST is recorded against the clean commit's input digest (ig-ast.ts source-inputs). The AST just built must itself be valid for the commit, or the run fails. BPMN activities of fhir-harness · source fhir-harness/processes/content/ig-ast-cache.bpmn#Task_Export . Build the Jekyll site and the API reference candidate, extracted Builds the composed source with Jekyll 4 and just-the-docs (bundle exec jekyll build), runs each composing Tool's post-build pass, mounts instance-rendered content (mount-instance-docs.ts), and generates the TypeScript API reference with TypeDoc (.github/actions/typedoc-api). The main deploy is a full build: every index is rebuilt from the tree being published. See skill feature-staging, section Build types. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/docs-site-publish.bpmn#Task_Build . Build the L1 knowledge graph candidate, extracted See ingest-build-l1-kg.bpmn. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/library/l1-document-ingestion.bpmn#CallActivity_BuildKg . Build the public comment release candidate, extracted Freeze the draft as "Draft for Public Comment Release vX": a PDF with fixed line numbers and a site copy under a permanent PC/<version>/ path (not branches/, never deleted on merge). Every channel cites this release's pages, lines and block ids. Line numbers run continuously through the document. Freeze from a FULL build: dispatch the preview workflow for the branch with build_type: full first, because a preview borrows main's search index and slices; pc:release freeze refuses a preview build. Run bun run cat pc:pdf for the line-numbered PDF and its line map, then bun run cat pc:release freeze for the write-once copy under PC/<version>/. Skill: document-publishing. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/public-comment-release.bpmn#Task_BuildPcRelease . Build the queue, grouped by owner candidate, extracted Read every bean copy, not only the one this checkout mounts; where copies disagree the newest updated_at wins and the disagreement is listed. Leave out goals and epics, blocked beans, closed or draft ones, owner-held or parked ones, and beans the drainers cannot reach — each with its reason, so nothing vanishes silently. Group the rest by owner in priority order, mark beans other agents hold as skip, and write one shared queue file. The drain-queue Tool (bean n7x7) builds this; until it is defined, the step is the skill's. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/bean-drain.bpmn#Drain_BuildQueue . Build the review page candidate, extracted translation:status writes review.html beside the status page, with assets/translation-status/review.json: every catalogue × locale, its state (machine, flagged, reviewed, stale, official), the candidates per string, and the hash of the catalogue's bytes. That hash is what the verdict is pinned to. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/translation-review-adjudication.bpmn#Task_TRA_ReviewPage . Build the tag in full and make the draft release candidate, extracted ig-release.yml (Tool ig-release): ig-ast-refresh.yml with force and release (never incremental), then ig-release.ts assets gathers package.tgz (and package.r4.tgz, package.r4b.tgz), ast-data.zip (the AST, Libraries with their ELM) and SHA256SUMS, and ig-release.ts draft makes or refreshes the GitHub draft for the tag. A tag with a published release is refused. BPMN activities of fhir-harness · source fhir-harness/processes/content/ig-release.bpmn#Task_ReleaseBuild . Build the test run candidate, extracted Assemble the run record the signature will cover: the data hash and the process hash, each all-or-nothing. An UNKNOWN_HASH never reproduces another unknown, so a run that could not be hashed is signable only as what it is — unverifiable. Builds a folio-test-run/v1. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/qa-report-signing.bpmn#Task_BuildRun . bun / pip dependencies candidate, extracted Component 2b. RESTORE: the package managers' download caches, keyed by the lockfile digest (bun.lock; the pip requirements file) and the tool version — never by a hand-listed version string. A restored download is re-verified by the package manager against the lockfile's integrity hashes: class (a). SAVE: main; a PR into its own ref scope. Owner role: the integrator (CI speed 14). cache node: bun-deps, pip-deps. It reports one line in cached-step's format — cached-step <step>: hit|warm|miss (<trust>) — <why>. Key <key>. — to the job summary, which the daily hit-rate report counts. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/cache.bpmn#Task_Deps .

6449.title: C
6449.content: Cancel queued PR runs; build, push, merge candidate, extracted Never cancel a main push run that has started. Build from fresh main with merge commits, skipping conflicts, .github/workflows/ and subscriptions/. Open one PR per repository, merge it with a merge commit, and comment on each member PR with the link. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/saturation-meta-merge.bpmn#Task_Land . Categorize and summarize candidate, extracted Each hit gets a category (overlaps: coordinate; affected by; out of scope; unrelated) and a one-line summary with its state. Judgement, not a keyword score: say why each is in its category. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/related-work.bpmn#A_Categorize . Check before you create (exact-title search) candidate, extracted STRICT. beans create is not idempotent: it mints a fresh id every call and dedupes on nothing, so re-entering a step duplicates the plan instead of no-op'ing. In the qou folio an unguarded re-run produced 14,688 duplicate beans — 92% of every open bean — which starved the idle-backlog policy of signal and collided with 15 real ids. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/bean-open.bpmn#Open_CheckExists . Check disk against lock against declaration candidate, extracted mount:remote:check, with no network: the lock's pins are the declaration's, and every locked directory is on disk and hashes to its digest. Could-not-determine outranks missing, which outranks mounted. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/mount-dependency.bpmn#Task_CheckAgainstLock . Check each page; OCR pages that fail candidate, extracted Owner, 2026-11-11 (who-iris, card Q-ODD-1 = A): "force OCR when a page's text layer fails a quality check". A text layer can hold plenty of letters and still not be the page's text: accents mapped to Greek letters ("dΘclaration"), Persian set in the wrong Arabic code points, words split by kerning ("au g m ente"), fake-bold words printed twice, mojibake. cat-harness-tools scripts/_text_quality.py checks every page against the document's languages (dc.language.iso, or --lang-hint); the router then OCRs the document and pdf-structure.py --ocr takes the OCR text for the failing pages only, listing them in structure.json source.ocr_pages with the reason. When most pages of a document with no outline fail, the whole document is read from OCR, as for a scan. Method: skill l1-document-ingestion, "A text layer that is not text". BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/ingest-extract-structure.bpmn#Task_PageCheck . Check field for field candidate, extracted fhir-harness/scripts/check-wireframe-questionnaire.ts <wireframe.html> <Questionnaire.json>, per layout. Exit 0 faithful, 1 a finding, 2 cannot tell, which is never a pass. The findings become the output's fidelity[] and are shown to the reviewers. BPMN activities of fhir-harness · source fhir-harness/processes/content/questionnaire-wireframe-review.bpmn#Task_Fidelity . Check glossary consistency candidate, extracted translation:glossary:check, against the layered term base: the normative reference glossaries first, then each layer in the order the index config lists it, the layer's own glossary last and never overriding. A platform term found in text of another subject area is a sense check for a person, not a violation. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/multi-locale-translation.bpmn#Task_ML_Glossary . Check glossary terms (translation:glossary:check) candidate, extracted After translating: run translation:glossary:check --instance <dir> --locale <locale>, fix the violations, and include its glossary section in the KG QA report. A term translated against the term base is a terminology miss, so it takes the drift branch to the adjudicator. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/translation-workflow.bpmn#Task_GlossaryCheck . Check it candidate, extracted Look, do not remember. The answer is one of the four states, and "could not determine" is its own answer: a check that could not look is not a pass. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/complete-initialization.bpmn#A_CheckStep . Check pages are current, links resolve candidate, extracted The generator's check mode regenerates in memory and fails on any difference from the committed pages, and on any source link that does not resolve. It runs in CI, so a change to an extraction or a library entry that was not republished fails the build rather than leaving a page that says something the extraction no longer does. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/publish-extracted-statements.bpmn#Task_CheckCurrent . Check staleness (source hash) candidate, extracted On source content change: computes sha256(source.md) and compares to each translation's status.json sourceHash. If they differ, sets stale: true. The translation remains visible with a "stale — needs re-adjudication" indicator. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/translation-workflow.bpmn#Task_StalenessCheck . Check the .jsonld siblings are in sync candidate, extracted Run the five --check generators in one job — the JSON-LD context, block siblings, library nodes, site graph, then the label-resolution and emitter tests. Any committed .jsonld that differs from what its generator now produces fails the PR, because a stale generated file is still consulted. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/jsonld-drift-check.bpmn#Call_Drift . Check the base AST against the inputs candidate, extracted ig-ast.ts validity <base> --ig <root>: folio-assistant-core's compiledValidity on the manifest's inputs, with the input digest recomputed by the same algorithm as the Java writer. Exit 0 valid, 1 stale-inputs (names which input), 2 cannot-tell. Run against the BASE revision's checkout. BPMN activities of fhir-harness · source fhir-harness/collab/processes/content/ig-ast-delta-review.bpmn#Task_Validity . Check the current version's tag and release candidate, extracted bun run fhir-harness/scripts/ig-release.ts check --ig . --repo <owner/repo> (Tool ig-release). Prints one notice per finding: version X is untagged: the owner tags commit <sha> with vX, or tag vX has no release: run "IG release (draft)" (ig-release.yml) by hand with tag vX, or that a draft waits for the owner. Exits 0 always; never tags and never releases. BPMN activities of fhir-harness · source fhir-harness/processes/content/ig-release.bpmn#Task_Check . Check the declaration and translations candidate, extracted Tool web-app-build (web-apps:build --check): the manifest parses, package.json has the build script, a lockfile pins exact versions, no two layers claim one app id, every template is current, and no translation drops or adds a {placeholder}. Untranslated strings are reported, not failed: the app falls back to the source text per string. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/web-app-publish.bpmn#A_Check . Check the JSON Schemas and JSON-LD are at their IRIs candidate, extracted THE PRIMARY STEP of initializing a Knowledge Graph harness and so the first one checked once the declarations are read. Every JSON Schema the harness publishes (its $id) and every JSON-LD document (its vocabulary, its diagram vocabulary, its graph export, each carrying its own @context) is at the address it names under iriBase, where a program following the IRI finds it. Two checks: that the site build stages each one at its address, and that each address answers. A 404 is not published; a 403 or no answer from here could not be determined. The Pages site is the vehicle: when the documents are not yet answering, the site steps below are how they get there, and the report leads with this step's state. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/complete-initialization.bpmn#A_CheckDocuments . Check the model parses and resolves candidate, extracted Tool archimate-check (archimate:validate, on the layer root): every model the config names is held and parses, every box in every view draws an element the model holds, every relationship's ends are in the model. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/archimate-publish.bpmn#A_Check . Check the profile candidate, extracted content_profile_check: no math kind, no lean field, no .lean sibling. A paper folio has no such step; this is why a document folio needs neither Lean nor TeX to publish. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/authoring-a-document.bpmn#Task_ProfileCheck . Check the selected methodology's evidence base candidate, extracted Before applying a methodology, establish that the thing being applied is what it claims to be. A methodology is adopted because it is somebody else's named, external work; this step checks that the origin it cites resolves to a source in a declared library, and reads the methodology-evidence QA sidecar for it. WHY THE CHECK IS HERE AND NOT AT ADOPTION. Adoption happens once; selection happens every time a decision is made. A source that was reachable when the methodology was adopted can stop being so, and a methodology adopted before this axis existed was never checked at all. Measured 2026-09-22: six methodologies cited an origin and NONE had that source in any library, so every selection made until then rested on an unverifiable citation. WHAT A GAP DOES AND DOES NOT DO. A missing source does NOT block the decision, and this step has no branch that stops the process — that would make a documentation gap into an outage, and the owner decides whether an unbacked methodology may still be used. It does two things: it runs literature-search to try to close the gap, and it puts the evidence state into the record A_Record writes, so a reader can tell a decision made on a verified method from one made on a citation nobody could follow. The third state is the one that matters. "Source ingested", "source located but unreachable from here" and "no source found" are three different facts, and literature-search exists largely to stop the middle one being reported as the last. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/options-analysis.bpmn#A_CheckEvidence . Check the slug and its confirmation candidate, extracted Guarded three ways because a dispatch input is a DELETION TRIGGER. workflow_dispatch is available only to an actor with write access; the slug must match exactly the characters the sed pipeline can produce, with . and .. refused by name; and the confirmation must repeat the slug, so a confirmation cannot be carried over from an earlier run against a different preview. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/feature-staging.bpmn#Task_Validate . Check translation completeness candidate, extracted Verify that all msgid entries have msgstr translations. Partial translations are acceptable for initial submissions but must be flagged for follow-up. The coordinator checks: - % of strings translated - Any fuzzy-flagged entries - Missing critical sections . BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/human-translation-workflow.bpmn#Task_CheckCompleteness . Check what is served candidate, extracted Ask the root URL and every document address. 2xx or 3xx answers; 404 is not there; 403, 407, 5xx or no answer is about the way here and could not be determined. BPMN activities of bootstrap-tools · source bootstrap-tools/processes/render-kg-to-github-pages.bpmn#A_CheckServed . Check what was staged candidate, extracted site.ts --check and readme-book.ts --check: every document at its address, no address taken by another file, every link on the page landing. This is the QA of what would be pushed. BPMN activities of bootstrap-tools · source bootstrap-tools/processes/render-kg-to-github-pages.bpmn#A_CheckStaged . Choose a candidate candidate, extracted A one-off choice between surviving candidates. Rejected candidates are kept, with the reason each lost. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/wireframe-design-review.bpmn#Call_Choose . Choose a destination, or none candidate, extracted A PERSON'S STEP, and none is one of the answers rather than a refusal to answer. A requirement whose whole content is carried by the code becomes a commit and nothing else; a graph that acquires a node for it is a graph with a node nobody will ever read. The default creates NOTHING. An agent that decides on its own that a requirement "is really a skill" has manufactured a node nobody asked for, in a graph somebody else maintains — which is what this step exists to prevent. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-signoff.bpmn#BA_ChooseKg . Choose A, B, C or D candidate, extracted Only the owner's own tap or words approve the landing. A PR the card does not name gets no merge from it. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/saturation-meta-merge.bpmn#Task_Owner . Choose from the offered options candidate, extracted The question is presented as a short list of selectable options, never as free prose, and the list names the top-level content types the agent knows about. The answer becomes the statedIntent fact and the table is evaluated again — the user's answer is read as evidence, like any other fact. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/conduct/getting-started.bpmn#Task_AskIntent . Choose subgraphs, assets, harnesses candidate, extracted Written to the entry as subgraphs, assets.policy (none, on-demand or all) and harnesses. Choosing is not holding: a chosen subgraph is still referenced until the gates below let it through. Choosing nothing is legitimate — a subscription with no parts chosen is a pinned reference, the case associatedHarnesses covers today. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/subscribe-kg.bpmn#Task_Choose . Choose what the harness reads candidate, extracted A PERSON'S STEP: the scan's markers that are not yet declared are offered as selectable options — one per marker, each with its paths and what declaring it means, plus "none of these" — and the person picks which parts of the repository to load into the KG. A tap card where the host has one; otherwise a numbered pick-list with a stated default. Never a typed reply. The default declares NOTHING. Only the picks reach Task_Scaffold, which declares exactly those in index.config.json. With no undeclared marker found, nothing is asked. The same question is put after setup by running the scan with --markers (repo-conversion §2a). BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/conduct/getting-started.bpmn#Task_ChooseHarnessed . Circulate the draft candidate, extracted The draft publication is circulated to the review team for formal review. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/draft-to-publication.bpmn#Task_CirculateDraft . Cite the author of every narrative candidate, extracted A generated description is a claim by someone. Record whether a human or an agent wrote it, and for an agent the model version. An uncited narrative is indistinguishable from a transcription of the source. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/ingest-derive-content.bpmn#Task_Provenance . Claim it (status: in-progress) candidate, extracted Idempotent. Claim BEFORE working, and note the branch, so a sibling session can see the item is taken rather than discovering it by collision. The only claim op in the corpus: every process that claims calls this process (check:bean-calls). BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/bean-open.bpmn#Open_Claim . Classify data set: fixed (curated) or generated (recipe) candidate, extracted Decide whether the test case requires a small, committed, cited fixed data set (test-data-fixed/1.0.0, usable as certification evidence once reviewed) or a deterministic generated recipe (test-data-generated/1.0.0, template + params + seed, never stored materialised). BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/test-data-curation.bpmn#Task_ClassifySet . Classify every conflicted path against the declared patterns candidate, extracted The first matching pattern decides: take-base, owned-tree, generated-regions, or refuse. A path no pattern names refuses. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/merge-base.bpmn#Task_Classify . Classify filing mode, concern group, and req:<slug> ID candidate, extracted Determine whether this filing promotes a proposal from docs/proposals/<slug>.md (promote), amends an existing requirement or replaces it with a new requirement (amend-or-supersede), or retires an obsolete requirement (retire). Assign the primary semantic concern group from code-lists/concern-group.json (sdlc, process, tools, kg, library, content, ui, conduct) and verify that req:<slug> does not collide across docs/proposals/ and docs/requirements/. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/requirements-filing.bpmn#A_ClassifyFiling . Classify what changed candidate, extracted Prose, code nodes, or both. This is the only decision the generic lane makes on its own: everything after it is made inside a subprocess by the role that lane binds. Binds content-review, the same skill as Task_Consolidate in this lane, because a paper skill belongs to the science layer, which this harness diagram cannot reach. A paper process that wants semantic scoping adds it by calling this process. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/content/review-task.bpmn#Task_ClassifyChange . Clinical or scientific sign-off candidate, extracted Domain sign-off: clinical SMEs for a guideline, subject-matter reviewers for a paper. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/draft-to-publication.bpmn#Task_SmeSignoff . Clone each IG at its recorded commit and stage it [stage-ig-sites] candidate, extracted Tool stage-ig-sites: bun run fhir-harness/scripts/stage-ig-sites.ts --work ./_ig --baseurl /<repo> --plantuml-jar <jar>. Clones each IG at its recorded commit and stages ONE just-the-docs Jekyll source per IG with Tool build-ig-site (pages, includes, images, PlantUML, _data/, theme colours); the artefact lists (artifacts, toc) are thin pages over the artefact index node (Liquid only under --full-pages), and the instance's artefact pages from Task_Pages are copied in. The theme is the one webpage theme the instance declares or inherits along needs; two at the same distance are refused. BPMN activities of fhir-harness · source fhir-harness/processes/tools/ig-docs-site-compose.bpmn#Task_Stage . Close issue ONLY on BA authorisation candidate, extracted Reachable only through BA_Confirm, which is the BA saying every criterion is met. An agent must never close an issue without that explicit authorisation — the gate is the preceding task, and this name says so rather than leaving a reader to trace the flow for it. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-close.bpmn#A_Close . Close the bean candidate, extracted Process_BeanClose on the bean just worked: complete and archive it on evidence, scrap it with its reasons, or record its blocker and hand it back to todo. The step is bound by the Tool, not by a calledElement: the step names skill docs-generation, each Tool that satisfies it and composes a site lists its own subprocesses, and those carry the steps; which layers compose a site is data in their declarations. 6450.content: Data model Entities + cardinalities candidate, extracted Between requirements and sign-off, and the order is the argument: requirements are statements about things, and the model says what the things ARE. Drafted earlier it is invented from nothing, since the entities come from the phase-2 BPA; drafted later, sign-off approves requirements whose nouns were never pinned — which is how two stakeholders approve one sentence meaning different things. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-requirements.bpmn#Call_DataModel . Decide each adaptation: keep, revise or retire candidate, extracted One recorded decision per affected adaptation, with its reason: keep it as is, revise it to the new version, or retire it because the new version now covers it. A decision to diverge from the new version is recorded as such. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/guideline-updates.bpmn#Task_Decide . Decide each theme candidate, extracted The asset carries no description. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/stalled-agent-triage.bpmn#U_Decide . Decide what may leave the repository candidate, extracted EDITORIAL, and it is stage 1 rather than a filter bolted to the exporter. kg-export produces the WHOLE graph because inspection wants the whole graph; a portal wants what its readers may see. Running the second as the first is how a QA verdict, a bean's blocking note or an unpublished draft reaches a public cache. Decided once, here, rather than at each consumer. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/kg-to-portal.bpmn#E_Scope . Decide, weighing the recommendations candidate, extracted public-comment decide, or decide: code on GitHub from a login in config.json editors. accepted, accepted-modified, not-accepted, noted, deferred; a reason for all but accepted. Also reopens a decided comment. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/public-comment.bpmn#Task_EditorDecides . Declare it in place, with its seam candidate, extracted <name>/<name>.json with name, version, repository (the planned home), livesAt (where it sits today), needs, and only the directories that exist, each declared with its files in one commit. <name>/platform.ts from the first commit, so no climb out of the directory ever needs rerouting. Scaffolded by init-folio --staged <path>, which writes those two files and nothing at the host root; never --instance, which writes a whole repository. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/sub-kg-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_Declare . Declare the model where a tool can read it candidate, extracted A model in prose is a proposal; a model in the declaration is a model. Ship a reader in the same change: a model that is only documentation goes inert. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-data-model.bpmn#A_Declare . Declare the mount: harness, repository, pin candidate, extracted A layer { name, source: { remote: { repository, ref } } } in the downstream's root index.config.json, written through writeDeclaredMounts. A folio with no index still reads remoteMounts on its declaration; both at once is refused. ref is a full 40-character commit. Overrides, if any, are keyed by layer name and then by directory id — never by path. The index itself is the index-config skill's. Decide first whether you want a remote mount at all: reading another graph without holding its code is a SUBSCRIPTION, not a mount. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/mount-dependency.bpmn#Task_DeclareMount . Declare the node materialized candidate, extracted The node's state moves from referenced to materialized, carrying purpose, localPath, gates and (archival) fixity. There is NO default state: a node that has not said is invalid, because 'the author did not say' and 'the author said they could not tell' are different facts. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/materialize-remote.bpmn#Task_Declare . Declare the purpose: working or archival candidate, extracted working or archival, and it is asked FIRST because three of the five gates mean different things under each. An archival copy keeps the original bytes, never expires, requires fixity, and is the only thing that discharges sourceLoss; a working copy keeps derived content and discharges none of that. A process that gated first and asked afterwards would be judging a copy whose obligations it did not yet know. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/materialize-remote.bpmn#Task_Purpose . Declare the web-app directory candidate, extracted The layer declares a directory of kind web-app in its <name>.json and puts a web-app.json (web-app/0.1.0) at its root: id, title, description, how it builds, the languages it ships (the site's six UN languages: ar, en, es, fr, ru, zh), the layer directories it reads at build time (contentFrom), a size budget, and for a copied app its licence and source. Its UI strings are one flat catalog in the source language (i18n.catalog). No publish script, no site.build.keep, no harness of its own. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/web-app-publish.bpmn#A_Declare . Declare, detangle, isolate candidate, extracted The graph-detanglement practice, all of its gates: declared in place, zero wrong-direction edges on every axis, and standing alone with its own declaration, namespace and artefact. A plain task on purpose, not a call to graph-detanglement.bpmn: that process ends in its own authorise-and-extract steps, which here are stages 9-13 of this one, and calling it would run them twice. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/kg-separation.bpmn#Task_Detangle . Deduplicate, and keep what is actually relevant candidate, extracted The paper's Refiner. Accumulates into the evidence set the report is built from — so what is dropped here is invisible downstream, which is why it is a step somebody performs rather than a filter buried in retrieval. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/deep-document-research.bpmn#A_Refine . Defer build and queue verify sweep candidate, extracted Set the preview/agent-build commit status on the PR head to pending, post the preview-build-verify notice on the PR, and exit the critical-path run so the runner is free. Off the critical path, preview-verify-sweep.yml (on staging workflow completion and every 15 minutes) waits until no Feature Staging run is active or queued, selects the oldest open PR whose head still has preview/agent-build = pending, and dispatches feature-staging.yml with verify_pr to rebuild and verify the agent's preview. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/feature-staging.bpmn#Task_Defer . Deploy the MVP to staging candidate, extracted An MVP is shared AS A branches/ DEPLOY, not as a description of one. feature-staging.yml publishes the branch under branches/<branch-slug>/ on gh-pages and comments the URL on the PR, so the stakeholder who tests it is looking at the built artefact rather than at a screenshot — the same argument the merge discipline makes about rendered work: holding a rendered change back for assessment makes assessment harder, not safer. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-deliver.bpmn#A_DeployStaging . Deploy the preview site candidate, extracted A preview never seeds the shared cache. BPMN activities of fhir-harness · source fhir-harness/collab/processes/content/ig-incremental-build.bpmn#Task_DeployPreview . Deploy the rendering candidate, extracted publish-site.ts commits the staged tree onto gh-pages as a full replace (run by the instance's Pages workflow on a push to main, or by an agent with its own git credentials); GitHub Pages then builds it from the branch. Rebuild and retry on a rejected push; never rebase the branch. The report names the gh-pages commit SHA. BPMN activities of bootstrap-tools · source bootstrap-tools/processes/render-kg-to-github-pages.bpmn#A_Deploy . Deploy the site candidate, extracted Deploy the site built from main or a release. Deploying is release-management, after a human authorised the release — an agent never records that authorisation. A release's files are not deployed to the site: a v* tag makes a GitHub draft release carrying them (ig-release.yml; skill ig-binary-artefacts §"Releasing"), which the owner publishes. Report the published URL only once it answers: a returned deploy is not a serving site. BPMN activities of fhir-harness · source fhir-harness/collab/processes/content/ig-incremental-build.bpmn#Task_Deploy . Deploy to branches/<slug>/ candidate, extracted The stage job copies the built site into gh-pages under branches/<branch-slug>/, then staging-share.ts apply keeps only the files that differ from the live site. The preview's staging-sw.js serves every other file from the live site and puts the staging banner back on it. Other previews and the main site are left as they are. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/content-change-review-stage.bpmn#Task_DeployStaging . Derive content from the assets candidate, extracted See ingest-derive-content.bpmn. Most of this subprocess is not implemented yet. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/library/l1-document-ingestion.bpmn#CallActivity_Derive . Derive the key candidate, extracted qa:publish --github reads the event: a push to main publishes under main/<sha>/, a pull request under pr/<n>/<head-sha>/ — the head that was tested, not the merge ref. It also reads whether the token can write, which the gateway after it routes on. The key is main/<sha> or pr/<n>/<sha>. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/qa-publish.bpmn#Task_DeriveKey . Derive the metamodel in use candidate, extracted Tool archimate-metamodel (archimate:metamodel --check, on the layer root): the element types the model uses and every (source type, relationship, target type) pattern, each checked against ArchiMate's relationship table. Placeholder elements named after their own type are reported, never fatal: removing them is the author's call. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/archimate-publish.bpmn#A_Metamodel . Derive the slug from the head ref candidate, extracted Derive the slug from the PR's head ref: every character outside [a-zA-Z0-9._-] becomes '-', runs of '-' collapse, and leading or trailing '-' is trimmed. It must be one safe path segment, checked by value. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/feature-staging.bpmn#Task_Slug . Describe the desired change candidate, extracted Author describes the content change in natural language. Example: "Update the immunization schedule to add a booster at 18 months." . BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/content-change-review.bpmn#Task_DescribeChange . Describe the intended change candidate, extracted The editor states the change in natural language; no content has moved yet. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/editing-hci-validation.bpmn#Task_DescribeChange . Describe the need (chat, issue, discussion) candidate, extracted The BA describes the capability gap in their own words. They do not need to know it is called CRDM. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-requirements.bpmn#BA_Submit . Design review candidate, extracted cat-harness Process_WireframeDesignReview: as-is use for a form that exists, design use for one being designed. This process does not restate the method. BPMN activities of fhir-harness · source fhir-harness/processes/content/questionnaire-wireframe-review.bpmn#Call_Review . Detect change scope & impact candidate, extracted Agent analyses the requested change: - Which content blocks are affected? - Are there downstream implications (indicators, referral logic, visit schedules)? - Will deterministic logic (CQL/DMN) need updating? skill: content-graph, integration-watcher . BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/content-change-review-make.bpmn#Task_DetectScope . Detect feature request (crdm-detect skill) candidate, extracted Recognise the request as a platform capability change rather than content work, from crdm-detect's signals. Never call it "CRDM" to the person. Mid-content-work, ask whether to pause for requirements now or record a work item for later — do not switch on your own. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-requirements.bpmn#A_Detect . Detect media type, mint a doc id candidate, extracted Sniff the media type rather than trusting the extension, and mint the doc id from the page-1 arXiv stamp where there is one, else from the filename. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/library/l1-document-ingestion.bpmn#Task_Detect . Detect the interaction modality candidate, extracted Before the first question is asked, establish HOW to ask it: audio, ordinary chat, selectable options for a user with limited hand function, large-type for low vision. A user who finds the questions unusable never reaches the rest of this diagram. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/conduct/getting-started.bpmn#Task_DetectModality . Detect what moved candidate, extracted translation:status --instance <root> for new, obsolete and fuzzy strings, and the instance's template check. Either failing, or showing anything but zero, is a change. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/translation-refresh.bpmn#Task_TR_Detect . Determine the content type and its specialisation candidate, extracted Read the folio's contentType and the specialisation registered for it (TestDataSpecialisationSchema in schemas/sdlc/test-data.ts): fhir-templating for FHIR IG and DAK content, markdown-fixture for document folios, lean-counterexample for proof folios, tabular-cohort for aggregate indicator tables. None registered stops here and says so, rather than guessing one. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/test-data-curation.bpmn#Task_DetermineSpecialisation . Determine the context: what is known, and already decided candidate, extracted Before composing anything: what is already known, each fact with where it came from; which declaration governs the matter (the layer's <name>.json, the diagram the caller is in, the Skill its task names); what state is recorded; and whether the question has ALREADY been decided — by the person earlier in the conversation, or in a declaration that quotes their ruling. A settled question is not asked again: asking it reopens a decision and spends the person's attention twice. Read it, do not remember it: cite what you read. What the caller handed in is checked here, not re-derived. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/human-agent-discussion.bpmn#A_DetermineContext . Determine the process and task, or that you are idle candidate, extracted Name the Process, the lane and the task the question belongs to, and say so in the message: "Process: Initialize a harness, at Determine the harness and repositories, as the Bootstrapping Agent". A reader who does not know which process you are in will assume the last one's rules still hold. If you are in no Process, that is an answer too: you are IDLE, and what you are doing is classifying a request to find the Process it belongs to — say that, rather than presenting a question as though a step had asked for it. You are OUT of process, and it is undetermined, when you cannot name the Process, when two candidates fit, when the step you believed was next is not the one the diagram enables, or when the work in hand was not what you said you would do. Do not infer your way back in. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/human-agent-discussion.bpmn#A_DetermineProcess . Determine the roles: which you act as, and the person's candidate, extracted An Actor performs a task in a Process AS a Role. Nothing is a Role by nature: the same agent is the Bootstrapping Agent in one diagram and another Role in the next, and which one it is depends on the lane of the task it is performing now. So say which Role you are acting as — the lane of the CALLING task, since this lane is variable — and which Role the person you ask holds (the Requestor, or whoever the calling lane names). It decides what you may ask them for: only the Requestor chooses a harness, and a question put to somebody who does not hold the decision gets an answer that settles nothing. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/human-agent-discussion.bpmn#A_DetermineRoles . Determine where you are: process, roles, context candidate, extracted Before narrowing, say where this is happening, in the words you will use in the question. PROCESS: Initialize a harness, at its first step, inside Determine the harness and repositories — the only place a Bootstrapping Agent can be (FR-2). If you cannot say that (you were started some other way, or a step you believed done is not), you are out of process: do not infer your way back in. ROLES: you act as the Bootstrapping Agent because you were told so; the person you will ask is the Requestor — the one who asked for the harness, and the only one who may choose it. A request relayed by somebody else leaves the Requestor undetermined. CONTEXT: what the request said, and what the checkout holds — a declaration at its root, a harness named in the request. Whatever cannot be determined is handed to the called discussion as undetermined, and asked about first; it is never filled with a default. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/discussion.bpmn#A_DetermineWhere . Determine which CDN, the root URL and the Subgraphs candidate, extracted Every Subgraph id asked for must be one the declaration lists; none means the whole graph. The root URL is the one given. The target's Tool is the one that satisfies: ["render-kg-to-cdn"] for that CDN — gh-pages for GitHub Pages. A caller that already rendered and verified its tree hands the tree over instead of the graph, and the Tool pushes it without rendering again. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/render-kg-to-cdn.bpmn#Task_Resolve . Determine which harness, and where candidate, extracted The candidates are listed and the Requestor is asked, in discussion, which asks through human-agent-discussion. IN: nothing but the context this agent was handed. OUT: zero or ONE harness, and the locations — a document conforming to discussion.output.schema.json. One at most: a list of two is not an answer, and the Bootstrapping Agent may not break the tie itself. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/initialize-harness.bpmn#A_DetermineHarness . Diff the two ASTs candidate, extracted ig-ast.ts diff <base> <head> --plan plan.json --site <site>/ast-delta/: resources added, removed, changed (with an element-level differential) and version-changed; edges added and removed; the plan's decision. Every page opens with the provisional mark and is wrapped in raw so narrative Liquid is not executed. BPMN activities of fhir-harness · source fhir-harness/collab/processes/content/ig-ast-delta-review.bpmn#Task_Diff . Discard all entries, or a whole session candidate, extracted Remove every entry, one session's, or those before a date — emptyLog with { all }, { session } or { before }; there is no default selector. A file that will not parse is kept, and the result must say what was refused and why, not only what was removed. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/activity-log.bpmn#A_EmptyAll . Discard one entry by id candidate, extracted Remove one entry by its stable id, with emptyLog({ id }). Logs are the one exception to the never-delete rule because an entry records no decision; the exception covers files that declare folio-log/v1, not the directory. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/activity-log.bpmn#A_EmptyOne . Discuss it with the person candidate, extracted Bootstrap's human-agent discussion, given the composed question. Its Ask ONE question step is where this harness's delivery rule applies: Post the whole composed question as ordinary chat text BEFORE any card. This is the copy that survives: a card, once answered, shows only the chosen option, and a dismissed card shows nothing. Never "see the card", never a request for a typed reply such as "1y 2n". Then the card: Whatever the host calls its selection tool (AskUserQuestion, request_decision, a button card): the same letters and labels as the chat text, the recommended option marked. No host card tool: say so in the chat and keep each answer to one short choice. Its answer step: One tap on the card, or any answer the person prefers to give. Free text is always available and never required. A dismissal is NOT an answer and never selects the default as a choice; the question stays open in the chat. On an answer: Hand the answer back to the calling step, quoted. If it settles how a kind of thing is decided, it is a rule: write it into the governing skill in the same turn. On no answer: Do what the question said would happen with no answer, and say so. Nothing irreversible proceeds on a default: such a step waits for the person. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/ask-the-person.bpmn#Call_Discuss . Dispatch a fixer candidate, extracted One fixer agent per cause, never one per repository. Give it the failing run, the cause and the repository: pins out of step go to the next re-pin train on the index; the layer's own bug to a fix PR in that layer; a lower layer's bug to a fix PR in the lower layer, then a re-pin. It opens a draft fix PR, linked from the main-red issue. The fix is a non-content P0 PR and follows the normal merge rules: the six-line request, the owner's batch card, full-tier CI green as judged. Close the loop when the next main run is green and the main-red issue closes. Never silence the failure, and never skip, disable or quarantine a gate or a test. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/merge-manager-watch.bpmn#Task_DispatchFixer . Dispatch AST refresh candidate, extracted Actions → "IG AST refresh (by hand)" → Run workflow on the default branch, inputs ref = the default branch, force = false. Set force = true only to rebuild a cache that is valid but suspected wrong. BPMN activities of fhir-harness · source fhir-harness/processes/content/ig-ast-cache.bpmn#Task_Dispatch . Dispatch one agent, recorded on the bean candidate, extracted Before the agent starts: the date, why the fail condition fired, the agent's id, its budget. Never while the first writer may still be live. Two failed attempts with the same cause go to the owner instead. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/merge-refusal.bpmn#Task_Dispatch . Dispatch with adjudicator_sees — never the artefact candidate, extracted UntaintedDispatch on the criterion declares what each party is given; the caller names a subject and a criterion and does not hand-assemble a brief, because the party composing a brief by hand is the producer. untaintedPartitionDefects reports overlap when the checker and the adjudicator can read the same file — one of them is then grading its own input, and the verdict measures nothing while raising no error. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/adjudication.bpmn#A_Dispatch . Distribute to the public candidate, extracted The committee and the editor send the announcement through their channels. Comment is open from here until the agreed close. Skill: public-comment. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/public-comment-release.bpmn#Task_Distribute . Do it, then check again candidate, extracted Only what the agent, or a tool it has, can do without replacing anything somebody wrote: regenerate a README section, add a missing Pages workflow, switch Pages on with an authenticated gh. Performing is not the same as done: the flow goes back to the check, and only the check says done. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/complete-initialization.bpmn#A_PerformStep . Do the work candidate, extracted The task itself. This diagram says nothing about how it is done; it only brackets it, so that a reader of the log can tell where one run of work began and ended. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/activity-log.bpmn#A_DoWork . Draft the block edit candidate, extracted The authoring agent produces a PROPOSED change. Nothing is written to the corpus yet. For a rendered change it also produces the before/after preview (skill before-after-preview) here, before Gateway_ValidationFork, so the preview exists when the parallel review starts. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/editing-hci-validation.bpmn#Task_DraftEdit . Draft, review and publish candidate, extracted See draft-to-publication.bpmn. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/content-lifecycle.bpmn#CallActivity_Publication . Drain: land, close or re-target the open PRs candidate, extracted Work the PRs seed:ready named until the source settles: land or close the heavy movers and the next layer's PRs, bring the layer's open PRs to five or fewer, and finish any move in flight. Fix a red rehearsal or a discovery miss where it is. Nothing is seeded from here; it goes back to the gateway, which re-asks. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/global-tasks.bpmn#GT_Drain . Drain: land, close or re-target the open PRs candidate, extracted Work the PRs seed:ready named until the source settles: land or close the heavy movers and the next layer's PRs, bring the layer's open PRs to five or fewer, and finish any move in flight. Fix a red rehearsal or a discovery miss where it is. Nothing is seeded from here; it goes back to the gateway, which re-asks. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/kg-separation-move.bpmn#Task_Drain . Draw the board of todos and beans candidate, extracted The todo board mounts inside the landing board, so harness cards and todo stickies share one surface. Each card carries an edit link only when the build composed one. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/harness-default-rendering.bpmn#A_Board . Draw the sample candidate, extracted On a first translation: every diagram label, every persona and scenario string, and a seeded random fraction of the rest, with the seed written down so the sample can be drawn again. On a refresh: only the strings that were new or fuzzy. Hand the back-translator the msgstr values alone, keyed by an opaque id. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/translation-round-trip.bpmn#Task_RT_Sample . Drop its positions and sweep orphans candidate, extracted Only after the content has moved: drop its positions from the layout layer and sweep any position whose note is now gone. Sweeping first would make the board authoritative over the folio for one step. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/ui/board-relocate.bpmn#A_UpdateLayer . Drop the file in the queue candidate, extracted Through the forge's upload form, a commit, or any other route that lands the file in the declared queue. The agent watches rather than chases: an arrival may be minutes or days away. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/content-acquisition.bpmn#P_Upload . Dry-run, then ask the owner naming every PR candidate, extracted Stack the PRs on a meta-merge branch without pushing. Then post the full question (include, leave out with the reason, merge method, per repository), followed by the card: A go, B also the red ones, C dry run only, D cancel. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/saturation-meta-merge.bpmn#Task_Ask .

6452.title: Glossary: BPMN activities, E–Q
6452.content: Candidate terms extracted from every BPMN task and call activity: name as the label, its own <documentation> as the definition, the element id as the code. Each is the asset’s own text, verbatim and not curated, and carries the badge “candidate, extracted”. A person promotes one by authoring it. Authored terms are on their owning instance’s page, and those pages, the counts and the sources are linked from the glossary index. From: bootstrap 38 (SKOS) · bootstrap-tools 7 (SKOS) · cat-harness 639 (SKOS) · fhir-harness 56 (SKOS) · folio-assistant-core 229 (SKOS). One of 3 pages of this type, split by the first letter of the label: all parts. Size: this page holds 308 terms and is 265 KB before compression, fetched in one request, within its budget of 1.0 MB. There is no search index: the filter below runs over this page, and the A–Z bar jumps within it. Already somebody else's concept? — check:term-mapping, bean 7wou | target | mapped | unmapped | undetermined | why undetermined | . | fhir | 0 | 956 | 0 | — | . | skos | 0 | 956 | 0 | — | . Undetermined is never “no match”. A vocabulary that could not be reached has said nothing, and the column above keeps that apart from a checked miss. The counts are reported and not graded: an unmapped candidate may be a term this corpus is right to coin. Per term. Every term on this page is unmapped on fhir, and unmapped on skos, unless its entry says otherwise. No entry says otherwise. Filter terms . 308 shown . E F G H I J K L M N O P Q

6453.title: E
6453.content: Edit deterministic logic (if needed) candidate, extracted If the content change affects decision logic, indicators, or workflows: - Update CQL expressions - Update DMN decision tables - Adjust indicator definitions skill: dak-authoring, fhir-pipeline . BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/content-change-review-make.bpmn#Task_EditLogic . Edit it in place — it is your own content candidate, extracted The ordinary path, drawn so the process does not read as though every edit needs a copy. Content in a writable directory is authored content and is edited where it lives; the copy-out is for somebody else's bytes, not for yours. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/copy-out-materialized.bpmn#Task_EditDirectly . Edit narrative content blocks candidate, extracted Agent modifies the relevant content blocks (.md files, block manifests). Validates each edit against the schema (content_validate). skill: content editing, block builders . BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/content-change-review-make.bpmn#Task_EditContent . Edit the document as decided, on a feature branch candidate, extracted public-comment edit --branch: the author (human, or an agent in the author role) edits the folio's blocks as the decision says, on a feature branch for one change-set. Its PR says Closes #N for the change-set issue, and opening it moves that issue's accepted comments to editing. Before its preview is staged, the author writes the change set's Disposition (change set) on the Agent tab: one line per comment (No. 136: Accepted...), starting from each comment's Blue Disposition on Review Public Comments, after an optional Overall statement. Quality check: every comment number in the change set has a disposition; the sheet flags gaps and words that differ from the people's. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/public-comment-change.bpmn#Task_AuthorEdits . Edit the document in the row's pull request candidate, extracted One row, one branch, one active pull request: the agent edits on the row's branch and opens its pull request, or updates it when the row comes round again. A closed pull request the committee wants back is reopened, or replaced by a new one on the same branch; earlier ones stay listed in Agentic status. Agentic status (Green) says where it is, and Staging review opens the preview's what-changed page. Before the preview is staged, the agent writes the change set's Disposition (change set) on the Agent tab: one line per feedback item, starting from the people's Blue Disposition, after an optional Overall statement; the sheet shows it in Disposition (agent) and flags any item without a disposition, or one that differs from the people's. It ends with Record agent step (record-agent-step.bpmn): the Agent tab row first, then Feedback (agent) from it, then the sheet read back, never Feedback (agent) alone. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/contributor-feedback.bpmn#Task_EditInPullRequest . Flows to Task_PoInject, so the round-trip QA runs again over the corrected text — "edit the translation and re-run QA", which is what the adjudication step has always offered and what this process could not do. A userTask, not a service task: this is the one step here where a person edits content, and the lane's actor is the reviewer who just adjudicated. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/translation-workflow.bpmn#Task_EditTranslation . The folio author may edit it in place, attach review comments, or raise todos (todo-manager) against it. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/copy-into-folio.bpmn#Task_WorkOnCopy . Editing and HCI validation candidate, extracted See editing-hci-validation.bpmn. Runs once per proposed change, not once per cycle. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/content-lifecycle.bpmn#CallActivity_Editing . Editing and HCI validation candidate, extracted The editing sub-process. Every change to the corpus goes through its HCI validation gate — a red draft is fixed there, never by patching the built artifact. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/collab/processes/content/draft-to-publication.bpmn#CallActivity_Editing . Eject the culprit, record why candidate, extracted T1 (R3; SQ19 §2.2 p. 3): the culprit leaves, the rest re-run. Writes ejection on its queue entry (train id, reason, evidence URL, when) and a dated evidence snapshot on this instance. The train is never rejected whole for one member. Stalled sessions are not candidates. Every sibling computes the same answer from the same listing (owner ruling, 2026-11-07). End-to-end + accessibility (HARD) candidate, extracted Install Chromium, check the rendered BPMN SVGs are current, then run the Playwright suite, which includes the accessibility checks. Hard: a failure blocks the PR. SHARDED since bean dlqu (drawn as one task, deliberately: a multi-instance marker would add a BPMN term to every instance's UML overview, about 75 generated files, for a picture this sentence already gives): the suite runs as three e2e-shard jobs (E2E_SHARD=i/3, one Playwright worker per core in each), and each shard is its own required check, so a shard that failed, was cancelled or never ran is a red check of its own. Until bean 5p4m (issue #2456) an e2e job carried one check name for the three and completed the task only when every instance succeeded; it was ~1 s of work behind a runner request that waited minutes, and was removed. Measured before the split: playwright test alone was 4m33s of a 5m16s job, the workflow's slowest once bun test ran in parallel. The BPMN-render and .bat-wrapper checks run in shard 1 only, so they are asked once. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/code-quality-gates.bpmn#Task_E2E . Whoever watches that label is alerted. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/publish-alert.bpmn#A_Label . Ensure the tracking label exists candidate, extracted Create the tracking label (the label input) with --force so it exists before either issue path runs — the close path filters on it too, and on a repository that has never had a finding it would not exist yet. Skipped on an unknown verdict. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/global-tasks.bpmn#GT_EnsureTrackingLabel . Ensure the tracking label exists candidate, extracted The asset carries no description. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/tracked-watch.bpmn#Task_Label . Three things come from it and none may be guessed. (1) Which subset strategies the source supports — supportsSubset(). (2) Whether a subset stands on its own: when subsetIsSelfContained is false (mathlib), the request is closed over its dependencies here, and every gate after this one is asked about the CLOSURE, because a subset that omits what its members depend on is not a smaller corpus, it is one that does not build. (3) What enumerating the whole costs — enumerationCost(), which is undefined when the descriptor has no measured denominator; SIZE then refuses rather than estimates. A source with no descriptor is not an error here: it is an unknown, and SIZE refuses on it. The descriptor is CALLED here rather than restated. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/materialize-remote.bpmn#Task_Enumerate . Establish origin and licence candidate, extracted Authors, publication, identifier, and the licence the source itself states. No stated licence means reference only: headings, page ranges and a summary in our own words; the file stays in uploads/ (git-ignored) pinned by checksum. A method with no origin is a house process; write a skill instead. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/methodology-from-source.bpmn#A_Origin . This step sees only the upload itself — the licence recorded in its intake.json (the same stated / unknown record a library manifest carries) and whether a LICENSE file sits beside it. It never infers a licence from extracted text. The verdict is stated, unknown, or UNDETERMINED, and undetermined is never reported as cleared: the pipeline proceeds and says so, because a licence that only extraction can reveal is a later check's to find. A case is executed or explicitly skipped with its reason; a case that simply has no verdict is a finding, because it cannot be told from a case nobody ran. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/sdlc/processes/test-plan-execution.bpmn#A_Execute . Explain each missing permission, with the exact config diff candidate, extracted Per permission: what it allows the agent to do without asking, why a process here needs it, the narrowest form that would do, and the exact change to the Tool's config. Context, options, recommendation, question (interaction-modality §4.1). Least privilege is the recommendation unless there is a measured reason for more. A locale that would need a different template is a defect in the extraction, not a reason to extract again. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/multi-locale-translation.bpmn#Task_ML_Extract . Extract figures and tables candidate, extracted The pdf-images.py, pdf-vector-labels.py and pdf-vector-figures.py arms extract the raster images and the figures drawn as vectors (grouped and rendered). For every table the document's structure declares, an agent reads the rendered page, checks cell text against the text layer, and writes tables/<label>.csv plus tables.csvw.json (folio-tabular-csvw/v1), with a draft description in the six UN languages; pdf-tables.py's grid is a cross-check, not the answer. Owner, 2026-11-11 (who-iris): "actually extract the figures" and "any tables too". Method: skill document-intake, "Figures and captioned tables: describe, keep, transcribe". BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/ingest-derive-content.bpmn#Task_FiguresTables . Extract its metadata into the KG candidate, extracted THE METADATA STEP. What enters the knowledge graph is the asset's INDEX — what it is, how big, what type, when it says it was written — and, for a container, what is in it; its contents do not go in unless somebody asks, with a reason. The tool is cat-harness-tools/scripts/extract-assets.ts, writing a folio-extraction/v1 record (schemas/content/extraction.ts). The media type is sniffed from the leading bytes, never taken from the extension. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/library/processes/document-ingestion.bpmn#Task_ExtractMetadata . Only fields read without guessing are set (address, DOI, ISBN, year, access date); a cited IRIS item the library holds gets heldAt. The nodes are the document's own bibliography on the bibliography page. A source with no reference list skips this step with nothing written.
